headline: Bitcoin is stuck near its lowest level since August as the Nvidia CEO's exit and rising bond yields drag on tech stocks, while US bitcoin ETFs extend a six-day run of outflows.

market.asOf: Bitcoin read from Yahoo Finance's live blog, last updated 8:57am PST (16:57 UTC, 23:57 Bangkok) Fri 13 Nov. Ether and Solana could not be read this run. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 20, the lowest since 8 July, per Bitcoin Magazine via KuCoin News (Fri 13 Nov).

stories.title: Bitcoin near 12-week lows as Nvidia shock and higher yields hit tech
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August, per TheStreet. US stocks turned lower as chip makers sold off after Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday, and the 10-year Treasury yield climbed. Higher yields and a likely Fed rate hike in December make risky assets like crypto less attractive.
points: Friday's low differs by source: $67,628 per BigGo, about $67,555 per Bitcoin Magazine via KuCoin News.
Bitcoin was at $68,867 at 10:25am ET per TheStreet; use the live prices on this page for the current level.
At 11:31am ET the Nasdaq was down 1.45% and AMD 9.9%, per Motley Fool.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose as high as 5.17%, its highest since October, per Yahoo Finance.

October wholesale prices (PPI) rose 0.3% on the month against 0.4% expected and 6.5% on the year, per Bitcoin Magazine via KuCoin News, which puts CME FedWatch odds at 88% for a quarter-point December hike and 12% for a half-point one.

stories.title: ETF outflows hit six days; Strategy to be dropped from MSCI indexes
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds lost money for a sixth straight day on Thursday, removing a key source of steady buying. Separately, index provider MSCI will remove Strategy (MSTR), the largest publicly traded corporate holder of bitcoin per Yahoo Finance, from its indexes at the end of November, which could force index funds to sell its shares.
points: Bitcoin ETFs had $284M of net outflows on 12 November, $204M of it from BlackRock's IBIT, per SoSoValue data reported by KuCoin News.
A smaller $47.7M figure shared Friday morning was preliminary and left out BlackRock and Fidelity, per CoinGlass via KuCoin.

MSCI will remove Strategy after the close on 30 November; Strategy estimates about $2.8B of its shares could be sold, and J.P. Morgan says up to $8.8B if other index providers follow, per Yahoo Finance.
Strategy shares were down 3.64% at $110.24 at 10:05am ET Friday, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: US moves to seize $1.2B stolen in North Korea's Binance hack
stories.summary: The US Justice Department says it has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2B of crypto stolen from Binance in a hack the FBI blames on North Korean hackers. Getting stolen coins frozen lowers the chance they are dumped on the market, but the case is a reminder that even the biggest exchanges can be hacked.
points: More than $6B was stolen in the Binance theft, per the Justice Department.
Joint government and private-sector efforts have frozen more than $2.7B so far, per the Justice Department.
The department also disrupted a deepfake scam operation it calls FaceStealer, which it says stole more than $400M in 18 months.
Binance put the stolen amount at about $6.34B, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Jensen Huang quits as Nvidia CEO
